title: loopzero-api Helm chart values schema
description: Plan v1.2 T2.5 / D4 — fail-fast on missing keys per ADR. Schema enforces image.tag (no 'latest' in drill/prod per Bug #16) and JWT_ISSUER/JWKS_URL required-by-env fields surfaced by Phase 2 layered values.

tag.description: Immutable image tag. Drill/prod MUST NOT use 'latest' (Bug #16 LIVE fix 2026-05-17): drill DOCR registry rejects 'latest' tags. Use commit-sha or release tag (e.g., 'drill-phase2-9ad223a5').

kubeContexts.description: Per-cluster kubectl context names, one per cluster loopzero-api drives: core (its own CR reconcile), build (Argo Workflow submission), cell0 (runtime manifest apply). "in-cluster" uses the pod's own ServiceAccount.

env.description: Plain-text env vars passed to loopzero-api Deployment (NOT secrets — those go via envFrom Secrets).

replicaCount.description: loopzero-api replica count. The Helmfile release sets it from the environment's `replicas.api`; 2+ gives HA with leader election (Bug #18 fix 2026-05-17).
